author: reek
body: The wrong direction at the argument boundary. apply-narrow will only ever write, and says so; broad may do anything Console. Handing broad over would let it read where only writing was promised, so it must be refused with CDX2090.

author: reek
body: This is the half that keeps the widening fix honest. The widening at the argument boundary rewrites a child label to the parent the parameter names, and only that: Console has no dot, so no label of apply-narrow's covers it, nothing is rewritten, and ordinary row unification refuses the program exactly as before.
